description: Local VM Backend - Run Orchestra on Ubuntu/WSL with FilesystemBackend, no TaskIQ

userStories.title: Add FilesystemBackend to sandbox factory
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Orchestra to support FilesystemBackend for local execution.
acceptanceCriteria: Import FilesystemBackend from deepagents.backends in backend/src/agents/__init__.py
Add BACKEND_TYPE env var to backend/src/constants/__init__.py (default auto, options: filesystem, daytona, state, auto)
Add WORKSPACE_ROOT env var to constants defaulting to ~/.ruska/workspace/
Create _create_filesystem_backend() factory function using FilesystemBackend with WORKSPACE_ROOT
Add filesystem key to _SANDBOX_FACTORIES dict
Update resolve_sandbox_backend() to respect BACKEND_TYPE env var
Auto-create WORKSPACE_ROOT directory on startup if it doesn't exist
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FilesystemBackend (lowercase 's') is the correct class name from deepagents.backends

userStories.title: Make TaskIQ workers optional
userStories.description: As a developer, I want TaskIQ to be optional so local mode doesn't require it.
acceptanceCriteria: In backend/src/routes/v0/llm.py wrap TaskIQ import in if DISTRIBUTED_WORKERS guard
In backend/src/workers/__init__.py make imports conditional
DISTRIBUTED_WORKERS=false skips all TaskIQ code paths
Move taskiq-redis to optional dependencies in backend/pyproject.toml
Backend starts without error when DISTRIBUTED_WORKERS=false
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: DISTRIBUTED_WORKERS already defaults to false in constants/__init__.py line 131

userStories.title: Create local environment configuration
userStories.description: As a DevOps engineer, I want to configure Orchestra for local deployment via env vars.
acceptanceCriteria: Create backend/.env.local.example with all local deployment variables documented
Add make local target to root Makefile that starts backend with local defaults
Add /api/health endpoint returning status ok, mode, and workspace path
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create install script
userStories.description: As a user, I want to install Orchestra on Ubuntu/WSL with a single curl command.
acceptanceCriteria: Script created at scripts/install.sh
Script detects OS and installs system deps: Python 3.12+, Node 22+, Redis, PostgreSQL
Script creates ~/.ruska/ directory structure
Script clones repo, creates venv, installs backend deps via uv
Script installs frontend deps and builds for production
Script generates .env from .env.local.example
Script runs database setup
Script is idempotent
Reference ruska-ai/sandboxes openclaw branch for patterns
userStories.notes: Script at scripts/install.sh - idempotent, detects OS, installs all deps

userStories.title: Create Docker test container
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a Docker container simulating an Ubuntu VM for testing.
acceptanceCriteria: docker/Dockerfile.local created based on ubuntu:24.04
Image includes Python 3.12, Node 22, Redis, PostgreSQL
Orchestra backend on port 8000, frontend on port 5173
~/.ruska/workspace/ created inside container
docker-compose.local.yml created
docker compose up starts Orchestra accessible at localhost:8000

userStories.title: Verify workspace is clean and push final changes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to ensure all changes are committed and pushed.
acceptanceCriteria: Run git status to check for uncommitted changes
If remaining changes exist, commit and push to branch
All commits visible in GitHub PR
